$comment: The external monitors, as a plan `tools/monitor-setup.mjs` applies and re-applies.
Declarative and idempotent in the manner of `dns-plan.json`: `status` prints the diff
and changes nothing, `--apply` makes the account match this file.
DEPLOY.md §'Uptime and certificate monitoring' explains why this cannot be the weekly
canary: GitHub disables scheduled workflows after 60 days of repository quiet, and a
site that is finished by design is quiet by design, so the canary switches off exactly
when it becomes the only thing watching. Liveness therefore runs outside the
repository — but its *configuration* lives here, where it can be read and checked.
Check 24 holds the account to this file.
$keywordComment: Better Stack puts the present/absent distinction in `monitor_type`, not in a flag
beside the keyword: `keyword` alerts when required_keyword is MISSING, and
`keyword_absence` alerts when it is PRESENT. One keyword per monitor. Two URLs and two
assertions each is therefore four monitors, not two — read off the API reference on
2026-08-11 rather than assumed from the UI.
The keyword pairs are not decoration. `/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection` appearing is
exactly what Cloudflare's Email Address Obfuscation does to the services CTA, which is
the only conversion path on the site; it is on by default, and this is the failure
with the longest tail. The same pair is used by tools/probe-live.mjs and by check 15:
one failure mode, one pair of strings, three places that look for it.
MEASURED 2026-08-11, not assumed: /oal/v1.0/ contains 'Ordoia Assurance Levels' six
times and 'mailto:hello@ordoia.com' ZERO times. A monitor asserting mailto: there
would have alerted on its first run. /services/ carries the mailto:.
$urlComment: The trailing slash on /oal/v1.0/ is load-bearing. MEASURED: /oal/v1.0 without it
returns 301 to the trailing-slash form, and a keyword monitor that does not follow
redirects sees a redirect body with none of these strings in it. DEPLOY.md's table
printed the slashless form until 2026-08-11. follow_redirects is set as well, so the
monitor survives the URL being written either way.
$defaultsComment: ssl_expiration and domain_expiration close the second half of BRIEF.md §9's ask, and
the domain-lapse worry §5 raises has been prose in a document until now. 30 days is
the last comfortable moment to renew a domain that a scorecard's printed address
depends on; 14 for the certificate, which Cloudflare renews automatically, so an alert
there means the automation has stopped rather than that a human forgot.
sms and call are off: this is a finished static site, and a 3am phone call for a page
